## Alternatives you considered

## Does it hold up against the project rules

Answer honestly. A request that fails one of these is not automatically
rejected, but it will be discussed on these terms.

- Does it stay free for every user? If a feature exists to extract money from
  someone who is lonely, it does not ship. No paywalls, no boosts, no "see who
  liked you" gate, no visibility that can be bought.
- Does it expose anything about location, about who swiped on whom, or about
  who blocked whom? Those three are the things this app most has to protect.
- Does it work on iOS, Android and web, or is it one platform only?
- Does it need a new table? If so it needs Row Level Security, grants, and a
  policy test, and CONTRIBUTING.md describes what that involves.
- Does it add a running cost? Hosting is donation funded and the budget is
  small.

## Anything else

Prior art, a sketch, or the way another app gets this wrong.
